connector.name: Filoo MCP
connector.registryDescription: Create short links, fetch click analytics, and generate QR codes via the filoo.app API.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the jrlprost account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: FILOO_API_KEY
env.description: filoo API key, starts with flo_live_. Get one at https://filoo.app/dashboard/api
